jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.
The Import Export organization builds and scales infrastructure for secure, reliable, high-throughput data movement across RelativityOne.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products.
You will collaborate with a senior engineering team and business stakeholders to build features and services that evolve RelativityOne SaaS.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Design architecture and non-functional aspects of Import/Export services aligned with SLO/SLA targets
Break down complex problems into resilient, cloud-native designs and deliver measurable outcomes
Mentor team members on code quality, best practices, and technical debt management
Own production systems, including on-call responsibilities, root cause analysis, and proactive issue resolution
Drive operational excellence through observability, alerting automation, and reliable metrics
Collaborate with Product to shape roadmap decisions using data and clear trade-offs
Improve CI/CD processes through automation and predictable, compliant deployments

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of experience building C#/.NET or similar services with demonstrated reliability or performance improvements
Experience designing distributed SaaS systems and translating business needs into technical solutions
Production ownership experience, including on-call rotations, incident response, and reducing MTTR using telemetry
Experience delivering cloud-native systems (Azure or similar platforms)
Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, testing, and deployment governance
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
English proficiency for technical communication

Preferred

Experience leading microservices development for high-volume, event-driven systems
Experience scaling ingestion pipelines, ETL workflows, or data processing systems with measurable outcomes
Experience mentoring teams in agile planning and cross-team collaboration

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

The Import Export organization is a high-impact engineering team within the Ingestion Department. The team builds and scales the infrastructure that powers secure, reliable, and high-throughput data movement across the RelativityOne SaaS platform.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, write, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products. You will work within an established senior engineering team and partner with business stakeholders to develop the products, features, and services that drive and evolve RelativityOne.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Create architecture and non-functional designs for Import/Export services that meet SLO and SLA targets.
Decompose complex problems into resilient, cloud-native solutions and deliver milestones with measurable outcomes.
Advise and mentor team members on code quality, technical debt management, and engineering best practices.
Own production systems by leading on-call activities, root cause analyses, and proactive issue resolution efforts that reduce MTTR.
Drive operational excellence by leveraging observability data to prioritize work, automate alerts, and expose trustworthy metrics.
Partner with Product to shape the roadmap through clear trade-off discussions and data-backed decisions.
Optimize CI/CD practices by designing automation that keeps deployments predictable and compliant.

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of experience delivering C#/.NET services or similar technologies with measurable reliability or performance improvements.
Experience architecting distributed SaaS systems and translating business requirements into resilient technical designs.
Proven production ownership experience, including leading on-call rotations, conducting root cause analyses, and using telemetry to reduce MTTR and incident volume.
Experience building and operating cloud-native solutions (Azure experience is a plus; any major cloud platform is acceptable).
Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, automated testing, and deployment governance.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Fluency in English with strong technical communication skills.

Preferred

Experience leading microservice initiatives for high-volume, event-driven workloads.
Experience scaling ingestion platforms, data pipelines, or ETL workflows with measurable outcomes.
Experience mentoring engineers and supporting agile planning and cross-team collaboration.

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

jobs.description:
Project Description:

Be part of a high-impact initiative at a leading global investment bank. We're building the next generation of the Multi-Tenant Enterprise Governed Data Platform (MEGDP)—a centralized, cloud-native analytics solution on Microsoft Azure. Supporting 50+ business units across Risk, Finance, Treasury, and more, MEGDP is key to the bank’s CCAR compliance and digital transformation.
We're looking for passionate technologists to help us scale a secure, production-ready platform that powers critical decision-making across the enterprise.

Key highlights:
• Mission-critical programme with direct exposure to regulatory and strategic priorities.
• End-to-end data architecture: ingestion from strategic source systems, real-time execution dashboards, and secure data egress.
• Scalable, future-ready platform addressing legacy limitations and enabling rapid response to evolving business needs.
• Career acceleration: work with cutting-edge tech, cross-functional teams, and a clear path for growth.

Responsibilities:

• Engineer robust test automation for a cutting-edge cloud data platform, ensuring it meets the complex data transformation needs of 50+ business tenants.
• Design and implement scalable, maintainable test frameworks that integrate seamlessly into our CI/CD pipelines, accelerating delivery and reducing defects.
• Collaborate closely with developers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, validate functionality, and deliver high-quality solutions.
• Own end-to-end testing of new features—from defining test strategies and writing automated tests to analyzing results and driving continuous improvements.
• Champion engineering excellence by identifying opportunities to optimize test coverage, reduce manual effort, and enhance platform reliability.
• Communicate progress and risks effectively, contributing to a culture of transparency, quality, and innovation.

Mandatory Skills Description:

• 7+ years of experience in Automation Testing with Java, preferably in Banking and Financial Services domain.
• Solid Java Backend development and testing experience along with with behavior-driven development and AI-assisted test automation.
• Proven ability to design and implement robust automated test cases in cloud-based environments (preferably Microsoft Azure) based on user stories and acceptance criteria.
• Solid understanding of SQL.
• Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, Git/GitHub/GitLab, and pipeline automation.
• Strong knowledge of performance testing, load testing, or security testing tools and methodologies.
• Strong problem-solving skills with experience in debugging complex systems and developing scalable test automation solutions.
• Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum environments with cross-functional teams.

(Opportunity for Poland-based candidates)

🏋🏽 MyBenefit program (sports card, well-being program etc.)

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm or Tallinn – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

You will join one of our product teams and on a daily basis:

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs
Years of experience using relational databases, preferably SQL Server. Additionally, working knowledge of ORMs, preferably Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud development; experience with Azure is a bonus
Practical knowledge of using messaging platforms in a distributed architecture (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Knowledge and experience on a FinTech and banking industry is a plus
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce, is a plus
Fluent English

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.

About The Technologies We Use

Our teams have autonomy when it comes to tech choices. The example below will give you some insights, and we are looking forward to discussing this further with you.

All solutions developed cloud-native targeting Azure - Infrastructure defined using Terraform - Services deployed to Kubernetes clusters by default - A growing microservice ecosystem with event-based integration - Using latest .NET Core - RESTful API design - Single-page frontend apps served by CDN - Frontend tech using TypeScript, often Angular or standard Web Components (Stencil) - Automated tests in each layer.

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

jobs.description:
Jobbeskrivning

Vill du utveckla system som bidrar till ett mer effektivt och fungerande samhälle? Hos oss arbetar du med lösningar inom bland annat vård, energi och offentlig sektor där kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet är avgörande.

Som .NET-utvecklare hos oss arbetar du som konsult i långsiktiga uppdrag tillsammans med kollegor och kund. Uppdragen varierar från vidareutveckling av befintliga system till nyutveckling och modernisering. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen och är med och fattar tekniska beslut som påverkar lösningarnas kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet. Hos oss får du arbeta i agila teamleveranser tillsammans med utvecklare, arkitekter, testare och verksamhet, där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Läs mer här.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Behind that journey sits a powerful digital platform enabling everything from checkout and payments to order management, delivery, retail tools, and customer self‑service.

You will join a focused team working across a critical part of the customer journey, building and validating solutions that customers globally and hundreds of internal users depend on every day. With real ownership, close collaboration, and global impact, this role plays a key part in ensuring reliability, performance, and quality across Polestar’s digital ecosystem.

We are now looking for a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join Polestar Digital at our headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you will ensure the reliability, performance, and quality of customer‑facing digital products and internal platforms that support the vehicle purchasing journey.

You will work across frontend, backend, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, validating solutions and ensuring that features meet both business and technical requirements before release. Acting as a key partner to Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and Operations teams, you will translate product requirements into effective test strategies and ensure that defects are identified early and resolved efficiently.

The role combines hands‑on testing, automation, and continuous improvement of quality practices, contributing to scalable and high‑quality systems used globally across markets and internal operations. You will also stay up to date with modern QA methodologies and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches.

What you'll do

You will ensure high‑quality delivery across Polestar’s digital platforms by validating solutions, improving test coverage, and driving continuous improvement in quality practices.

Your Responsibilities Include

Ensuring business requirements and acceptance criteria are fulfilled through comprehensive testing of user stories and system workflows
Designing, executing, and maintaining manual and automated tests across frontend, backend, APIs, and integrations
Validating quality, reliability, performance, and security of new platform capabilities and releases
Collaborating with Software Engineers, Technical Leads, Product Managers, and Designers to translate product requirements into effective test strategies
Identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and tracking defects, while supporting teams in root‑cause analysis and resolution
Contributing to test automation frameworks and improving overall test coverage and development practices
Working closely with cross‑functional agile teams to continuously improve software quality and delivery processes
Monitoring and evaluating quality metrics and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives
Staying up to date with industry best practices, modern QA methodologies, and emerging technologies, including AI‑assisted testing approaches
Documenting test plans, test results, and quality standards across the development lifecycle

In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, Technical Leads, and Operations teams, ensuring alignment across technical and business needs while driving quality across the full development lifecycle.

Who you are

You are a structured and analytical quality professional with strong ownership and a proactive approach to ensuring high‑quality outcomes. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with cross‑functional teams, and you focus on identifying and resolving issues early to enable smooth and reliable delivery.

You combine hands‑on testing expertise with a continuous improvement mindset and an interest in modern technologies shaping the future of software quality.

To be a great fit for this position, we believe you have:

Strong knowledge and hands‑on experience with Quality Assurance methodologies and software testing principles
Experience testing modern web applications and distributed systems across frontend and backend technologies
Experience with test automation tools and frameworks for UI, API, and integration testing
Understanding of React, TypeScript, .NET (C#), Node.js, APIs, and AWS‑based systems from a testing perspective
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub workflows, and containerized environments
Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and experience working in cross‑functional product teams
Strong analytical, organizational, problem‑solving, and communication skills
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams and stakeholders
Experience with commerce, payments, financing, order management, or customer journey platforms is considered an advantage
Atleast 4 years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance

People at Polestar

We know that a change is needed. We also know that each one of us can help bring about that change. Our commitment to becoming climate‑neutral by 2040 is just as important to us as being inclusive, diverse, and innovative.

Together, we are creating, collaborating, and experimenting to usher in a new era of sustainable mobility. We are an electric performance brand, determined to improve the society we live in.

Is this you?

If you are interested in joining the Polestar crew, don’t wait to submit your application. We apply a continuous selection process and the job post will remain open until the position is filled.

As we move through the Swedish summer holiday season, there may be a slight delay in our process. We look forward to getting back to you in August.

Send us your resume along with a short note on what makes this role interesting to you. We read everything.

Are you ready for the journey? Which is electric, by the way…

Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

Enligt överenskommelse.

40 timmar per vecka.

Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

Att det måste gå att få moderna digitala verktyg och traditionell fysisk vård att samverka med utgångspunkt i patientens behov. Do you want to make the world a safer place while being part of a team that truly values experience and collaboration?

Would you like to join a global and technically skilled team that plays an essential role in Verisure’s success?

The platform organisation in Malmö develops and operates the software that underpins Verisure's alarm and smart home systems. We are responsible for the services that keep millions of connected devices online, upgradeable, and traceable, from the moment a device is manufactured until it is returned or decommissioned.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Developer in Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U), you will join a team of around 11 backend engineers building and operating a portfolio of internal platform services. These cover device lifecycle management (factory provisioning, firmware upgrades, SIM management) and internal operator and support tooling used daily by Verisure technicians and administrators. Several of these services run with 24/7 SLA requirements; device provisioning and support tooling are business-critical, always-on parts of the platform.

You will design, build, and operate microservices spanning device lifecycle management, SIM connectivity, firmware/upgrade orchestration, and internal utility tooling. You will work closely with the team's Product Owner, fellow developers, and PU&U's external EMS partners to translate manufacturing and operational requirements into reliable software. You are expected to take technical ownership of parts of the system, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor less experienced developers.

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation, not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages, spanning millions of connected devices, is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Location:
Malmö (5-minute walk from the Central Station)

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation — not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. We are looking for an experienced backend developer with a strong technical foundation and the confidence to take ownership of complex, business-critical services. Experience with containerised deployment (Docker, Kubernetes)

Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.

For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company’s track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.

Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.

Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed in the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, this was the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in over 25 years.

Forvis Mazars
Grow. Belong. Impact.

Forvis Mazars in Ireland is a leading professional services firm with ambitious growth plans and over 1000 staff based in Cork, Dublin, Galway and Limerick. Our people first approach offers our teams a caring work environment which promotes belonging and inclusivity of all cultures and perspectives.

The Position

We are looking for a Senior GenAI and Azure Developer to join our team and work remotely with Ireland-based teams.

The Senior GenAI and Azure Developer will support the design, development and deployment of generative AI and automation solutions within the firm. The role will have a strong focus on building secure, scalable and production-ready AI applications using Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Foundry.

The successful candidate will bring practical experience in building generative AI solutions, together with an in-depth understanding of Azure and how its services, security model and networking behave, so that they can design, build and troubleshoot applications effectively. The candidate will help the team move solutions from business requirements to initial proof of concept through to secure deployment and ongoing production support. The position requires a strong technical foundation, together with the ability to apply appropriate architecture, security, governance and quality standards throughout the solution lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Generative AI Development & Research

Design & Developmen
t
Design and develop generative AI applications aligned with defined business requirements, using Microsoft Foundry and related Azure AI services.
Select and implement the right solution pattern for each use case, from direct LLM-based pipelines to grounded solutions that draw on enterprise knowledge and agentic approaches for complex, multi-step or tool-enabled workflows.
Build the data and retrieval layers that ground AI solutions in enterprise content, including ingestion, ontologies, indexing, graph, search, permission-aware access and clear citations.
Develop AI assistants and agent-based solutions using pro-code and low-code approaches across Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio and related technologies, integrating with enterprise data sources, APIs, Microsoft 365 and approved business systems.
Contribute to reusable technical patterns and components, following established engineering and governance standards.

Testing & Optimisation

Develop and carry out testing to ensure AI solutions meet quality, performance, security and compliance requirements, using representative business scenarios, edge cases and known failure conditions.
Evaluate the accuracy, relevance and groundedness of responses, and apply prompt refinement, retrieval tuning and model-level adjustments to improve quality and reduce hallucinations.
Perform regression testing when models, prompts, data sources or application components change.
Use monitoring, tracing and evaluation tools to identify improvements, balancing performance, latency, reliability and cost.

Innovation & Research

Stay informed of developments in generative AI, agentic AI, Microsoft Foundry and Azure, and assess new models, frameworks and platform capabilities against practical business and technical requirements.
Participate in proofs of concept and pilot initiatives to assess feasibility, risk and value, ensuring each has a realistic route to secure production deployment.
Evaluate when managed Microsoft capabilities are appropriate and when a more configurable or custom implementation is required.
Present technical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Azure Solution Development

Design and build GenAI and automation applications on Azure, selecting the appropriate services for each requirement, such as Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, App Service, Container Apps, Storage, Cosmos DB, AI Gateway, MCP server, Key Vault and API Management.
Apply a solid understanding of Azure architecture to design decisions on availability, resilience, scalability, performance and cost.
Implement secure access using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, Azure role-based access control and Key Vault.
Develop applications that work correctly in secured, privately networked environments, understanding the effect of private endpoints, private DNS and disabled public access, and diagnosing connectivity issues from the application side.
Work within the organisation’s Azure landing zones, policies and environment structure (development, testing, staging and production).
Build, test and deploy applications using Git, Azure DevOps pipelines and containers, working with established pipelines and templates provided by platform teams.
Prepare clear infrastructure, networking and access requirements when support from IT or Cloud Platform teams is needed.

Security by Design & Responsible AI

Apply security-by-design and privacy-by-design principles throughout the solution lifecycle, ensuring that users, applications and AI agents only access the data, documents and tools they are authorised to use.
Implement safeguards against prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, harmful content and unauthorised information retrieval, treating retrieved and external content as potentially untrusted.
Ensure that personal, confidential or sensitive information is appropriately protected in prompts, outputs and operational logs.
Include human review and approval where an AI-supported action is sensitive, external-facing or difficult to reverse.
Follow the firm’s Responsible AI, data-protection, information-security and governance requirements.

Process Improvement

Support the identification and assessment of business processes for automation opportunities.
Implement practical, maintainable solutions that improve efficiency, reduce errors and align with the intended business outcome.

Monitoring & Maintenance

Monitor deployed AI and automation solutions for reliability, performance and cost using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics and relevant Microsoft Foundry capabilities.
Configure appropriate logging and alerts while avoiding unnecessary storage of personal or confidential information.
Investigate and resolve issues across the application, data, integration and Azure service layers, escalating infrastructure and network matters to platform teams where appropriate.
Support controlled production releases, rollback and recovery, and apply fixes and enhancements as incidents, process changes or requirements evolve.

Integration & Collaboration

Work with business stakeholders to translate requirements into suitable AI, Azure and automation solutions, supporting requirements gathering, user acceptance testing and iterative improvement.
Collaborate with developers, IT, Cloud Platform, security, risk, compliance and data-protection teams, and integrate solutions with Microsoft 365, enterprise databases, APIs and approved external services.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and costs clearly, and review proofs of concept to identify what is required to make them secure, maintainable and production-ready.
Support other team members through technical guidance, code reviews and knowledge sharing.

Governance & Best Practices

Follow established ethical guidelines, data-protection requirements and internal governance policies.
Maintain appropriate source-control, versioning (including prompts and configurations), testing and release standards.
Document key technical decisions, risks and limitations, and contribute to reusable engineering standards and approved solution patterns.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

Maintain technical documentation for AI and automation solutions, including architecture diagrams, data flows, deployment instructions and operational runbooks.
Document the Azure resources, identities, permissions and integrations a solution depends on, along with its data ingestion, retrieval and evaluation approach.
Support the development of user guides and training materials, and share lessons learned through code reviews and technical walkthroughs.

Ideal Candidate

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud Computing or a related technical field.
Advanced degrees or relevant Microsoft Azure certifications are an advantage.

Experience

At least 5 years’ experience in software development, AI engineering or a related technical role.
Practical experience designing and delivering generative AI solutions, from business requirements to proof of concept through to production.
Strong experience developing, deploying and supporting applications within Microsoft Azure, including secure or privately networked environments.

Understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities and Azure role-based access control.
Working knowledge of Git, Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines and Docker; experience with Bicep, Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code technology is beneficial.

Understanding of secure application configuration, error handling, logging and dependency management.
Experience with PowerShell, JavaScript, TypeScript or C# is beneficial.

jobs.title: QC Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About Astellas

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com .

Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

Working Environment and Location

This position is 100% onsite in Tralee, Ireland.

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility Guidelines.

Purpose and Scope

Responsible for the administration, support, maintenance, and continuous improvement of QC laboratory computerized systems and automated laboratory equipment. The role ensures reliable, compliant, and secure operation of laboratory systems, supporting laboratory operations, data integrity requirements, system integrations, and regulatory compliance within a GMP environment.
Provide technical ownership and lifecycle management of QC laboratory systems and automated laboratory equipment.
Support administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of laboratory platforms including Empower, LabX, LIMS, and instrument control software.
Manage system integrations between laboratory instruments, enterprise applications, Active Directory, and site IT/OT infrastructure.
Coordinate system patching, upgrades, backup and recovery activities in line with site procedures and vendor recommendations.
Support qualification, validation, change control, periodic review, and audit readiness activities for laboratory computerized systems.
Develop and maintain system documentation, administration procedures, support guides, and asset inventories.

Role and Responsibilities

Own the administration, support, maintenance, and lifecycle management of QC laboratory computerized systems and automated equipment.
Ensure reliable, secure, compliant operation of laboratory systems within a GMP environment, with a focus on data integrity and regulatory requirements.
Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain laboratory platforms including Empower, LabX, LIMS, and instrument control software.
Manage integrations between laboratory instruments, enterprise applications, Active Directory, and site IT/OT infrastructure.
Coordinate system patching, upgrades, backups, recovery, qualification, validation, change control, and periodic reviews.
Maintain system documentation, procedures, support guides, asset inventories, and audit readiness.

Essential Qualifications

Third-level qualification in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Automation, or a related discipline, with experience supporting computerized laboratory systems in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical/biotech environment.
Experience with laboratory applications such as Empower, LabX, LIMS, CDS, and ELN, including laboratory instrument connectivity, system integrations, and IT/OT networking.
Strong Windows Server, Active Directory, user management, security, and system administration skills, with proven troubleshooting capability across software, hardware, network, and instrument communication issues.

Benefits

Careers | Astellas

Why Astellas

Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.

jobs.description:
Senior fullstackutvikler – Java eller .NET

Hva om du kunne være med på å bygge konsulentselskapet du selv ønsker å jobbe i?
CLEF er et nytt IT-konsulenthus der erfarne folk får påvirke oppdragene de tar, fagmiljøet de blir en del av og hvordan selskapet utvikles. Vi er åpne om lønn og vilkår fra første samtale. Nå ser vi etter senior fullstackutviklere til CLEF Consulting.

Dette vil du jobbe med

Du utvikler digitale tjenester hos kunder, fra brukergrensesnitt til backend, API-er og integrasjoner. Oppdragene vil variere, men fellesnevneren er at du får bruke erfaringen din til å bygge løsninger som er gode å bruke, videreutvikle og drifte.

Du samarbeider med utviklere, designere, arkitekter og fagfolk hos kunden. Du bidrar i tekniske valg, testing og kodegjennomgang, og deler gjerne kunnskap med andre i teamet. Mellom oppdrag kan du også bruke tid på faglig utvikling, tilbudsarbeid eller CLEFs egne verktøy.

Vi tror du passer hos oss hvis du

har solid erfaring med Java/Kotlin og Spring Boot eller C# og .NET/ASP.NET Core

har jobbet med frontend, gjerne React og TypeScript

kan utvikle API-er og integrasjoner og har god forståelse for SQL og relasjonsdatabaser
er opptatt av kodekvalitet, testing, sikkerhet og løsninger som tåler endring
samarbeider godt med kunder og kolleger og kan kommunisere godt på norsk, muntlig og skriftlig

Vi ser helst etter deg med minst fem års relevant erfaring, men vurderer også andre profiler som passer godt. Erfaring med Azure eller andre skyplattformer, CI/CD, containere eller større systemmiljøer er en fordel.

Dette får du hos CLEF

En åpen lønnsmodell:
Du får 65 % av fakturerbar årsinntekt, inkludert feriepengeavsetning. Pensjon kommer i tillegg. Prøv ulike timepriser og timetall i lønnskalkulatoren vår.
Trygghet mellom oppdrag:
Du er fast ansatt og har en garantilønn på 4G uavhengig av fakturering.
Innflytelse på oppdragene:
Vi vurderer aktuelle oppdrag sammen.
Mulighet for medeierskap:
Ansatte kan tjene opp eierandeler over tid. Vi går gjennom modellen og vilkårene i rekrutteringsprosessen.

De fleste oppdragene er i Oslo-området og krever noe tilstedeværelse hos kunden kombinert med mulighet for hjemmekontor. Omfanget avklares før du sier ja til et oppdrag.

Nysgjerrig?

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We make cargo talk. Why? Because a third of all food and pharma produce is wasted on the way to consumers, and we're out to change that. Our smart tracker Emma, made from recycled ocean plastic, travels with temperature-sensitive shipments for enterprise customers in food, pharma and seafood across 20+ countries. We're looking for a seasoned engineer to own the platform behind it, and to build it for ten times the fleet we run today.

What you'll do Own our Azure cloud platform end to end: architecture, ingestion, data, cost, and the calls about what we run and why.
Push AI-assisted development further than most dare. Claude writes most of our code and a human owns every merge. You'll define how far that goes for production infrastructure, and build the guardrails.
Scale ingestion and the data tier for a fast-growing fleet, without per-device cloud cost rising with it.
Make reliability unremarkable: no reading silently lost, late and backfilled data handled gracefully, and monitoring that spots trouble before a customer does.
Grow the data platform so questions about the fleet or a single shipment are answered in seconds, not filed as tickets.

Our stack A cloud-native platform on Azure: event-driven IoT ingestion, serverless services, and both operational and analytical data stores. CI/CD carries much of what we ship, a human reviews every change, and turning more of our infrastructure into code is a job we want you to own. AI runs through development, operations and analysis, and we are leaning into what is now just possible. We're ISO 27001 certified and our customers are audited, so security shapes real engineering decisions. We'll go through the details with you in the interview.

What you bring Deep experience in building and operating production cloud infrastructure: Azure, or another major cloud and the appetite to go Azure-deep.
Real conviction about AI-assisted development, with the judgement to know when to slow down and verify.
A curious, fast-learning mind. Being a jack-of-all-trades is a real plus here.
Fluency with infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability.
Strong Postgres and SQL, and sound instincts for modelling time-series data at volume.

Nice to have: IoT or telemetry at fleet scale, cellular (LTE-M, NB-IoT), ISO 27001/SOC 2 environments, Python, and cloud cost engineering.

What we offer Competitive salary, good pension, and share options. Own a piece of what you build.
Flexible hours and location; a welcoming office at Kjelsås Stasjon with parking and good transit connections. Our team tends to spend about half their time at the HQ.
Your choice of tools, plus best-in-class AI tools with generous quotas.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Som Senior DevOps Engineer hos Webstep får du muligheten til å jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom utvikling, operations og plattform for noen av de viktigste virksomhetene i Norge. Du får samarbeide med dyktige fagfolk som brenner for teknologi, og du får frihet til å ta ansvar, påvirke beslutninger og bidra til å utvikle fremtidens løsninger.

Vi ser etter deg som vil være med å bygge et av Norges sterkeste fagmiljøer for seniorkonsulenter. Hos oss handler det ikke bare om å levere. Det handler om å skape løsninger som varer, og å gjøre det sammen med folk du trives med.

Vi ønsker at du har:

Minimum 5 års erfaring som DevOps Engineer, eller 3+ års utviklererfaring kombinert med 2+ års DevOps-erfaring
Solid forståelse av nettverk og sikkerhet, logging, varsling og hvordan applikasjoner kommuniserer (REST, messaging services, monitorering og overvåkning)
Erfaring med Infrastructure as Code (IaC) og scripting, gjerne med Terraform, Bicep, eller Ansible.
Hands-on erfaring med containere (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD og minst én av skyplattformene Azure, AWS eller GCP
Erfaring med å sette opp enterprise-løsninger for autentisering og tilgangsstyring (f.eks. GitHub Enterprise), og strukturere arbeidsmetodikk på tvers av team
Du trives med å jobbe tett med kunder, forstår deres behov og bryr deg om at løsningene faktisk fungerer i praksis
Du er god til å forklare komplekse løsninger på en enkel måte, både muntlig og skriftlig, på norsk og engelsk
Sertifiseringer som AZ-305, AZ-400, KCNA eller andre generelle sky/devops-sertifiseringer er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som trives med mange baller i lufta og ad-hoc-styrte dager der ting skjer kontinuerlig. Du er fleksibel, tar initiativ og finner motivasjon i å være den som binder sammen utvikling, operations og plattform.

Du bryr deg om mer enn bare kode og infrastruktur. Du leverer godt, tar initiativ og involverer deg i det som skjer. Enten det er på Slack, et arrangement eller ute hos kunde. Du har høy integritet og vet at ved å dele kunnskap så blir alle bedre. Kanskje liker du å skrive blogger, holde foredrag eller bidra i faggrupper? Hos oss får du muligheten til nettopp det. De beste løsningene skapes tross alt i team der folk utfordrer hverandre og tør å tenke nytt.

Du er kanskje en person som forventer at arbeidsgiver skal stille samme høye krav til seg selv som de gjør til sine ansatte. Du bryr deg om trivsel, faglig utvikling og langsiktig vekst, og ønsker å være en del av et selskap som virkelig investerer i folkene sine.

Hvorfor Webstep?

Webstep er bygget på tanken om at de beste løsningene skapes av folk som har det bra. Derfor investerer vi tungt i både faglig utvikling og sosiale arenaer. Ikke fordi vi må, men fordi vi mener det.

Faglig utvikling på dine premisser

Hos oss får du tilgang til et av bransjens sterkeste fagmiljøer. Vi deler kunnskap på fagkvelder, kompetansehelger og vår årlige fagdag: en intern konferanse der kolleger holder innlegg, vi flyr inn inspirerende keynote-speakers, og det hele avsluttes med fest og sosialt. Fagdagen skjer på en lørdag, slik at du ikke mister lønn for å delta.
Vi deltar på og er sponsorer for konferanser som JavaZone og NDN, og støtter sertifiseringer og kurs som gir mening for deg. Vi har også rollen som faglig fyrtårn! Rollen går på åremål og du blir løftet fram for å representere Webstep faglig, holde foredrag og sitte i vårt nasjonale fagråd. Med andre ord kan du være med å sette Websteps faglige retning!
Brenner du for noe spesifikt? Kanskje du vil starte en faggruppe med fokus på platform engineering, sette opp et hackathon, eller få inn en internasjonal ekspert til å snakke om et tema du er opptatt av? Bare spør. Vi sier sjelden nei til gode initiativ.

En kultur som faktisk fungerer

Vi er ikke bare kollegaer. Vi er folk som kjenner hverandre godt. Gjennom året møtes vi på nyttårsbord, sommerfest, vintertur, høsttur (til utlandet), konsulenttur, lønningspils og bedriftslag som klatring, padel, sjakk og brettspill. Og ja, familien din er velkommen med på flere sosiale sammenkomster i året. Vi tror at når du blir kjent med kollegaene dine utover jobb, bygger vi et sterkere fellesskap.

Vår organisasjonsstruktur er flat og uformell. Vi har ingen lag på lag med ledelse. Konsulentledere har én jobb: å følge opp deg. Ikke rekruttering, ikke salg, ikke ti andre oppgaver, bare deg. Vår CEO sitter på kontoret, er tilgjengelig og har åpen dør. Det er lav terskel for å slå av en prat med hvem som helst, uansett rolle.

Frihet og fleksibilitet

Hos oss får du frihet til å velge prosjekter som passer deg, og fleksibilitet til å legge opp hverdagen din sammen med kunden. Er det greit for kunden, er det greit for Webstep. Vi tror at folk som får frihet, tar ansvar, og det er akkurat sånn vi liker å jobbe.
Du får jobbe med spennende kunder i bransjer som energi, bank og finans, helse, handel og offentlig sektor. Det betyr at du kan bidra til å forme samfunnet, samtidig som du utvikler deg faglig .

Et arbeidsmiljø som investerer i deg

Vi kutter aldri på fag eller sosialt. Vi bruker betydelige ressurser på trivsel, kompetansebygging og på å skape en arbeidsplass der folk faktisk vil være. Vi har gode forsikringer, pensjonsordning og konkurransedyktig lønn, men det viktigste for oss er at du føler at du vokser, både faglig og som menneske.

Klar for å ta Websteppet?

Har du kompetansen, engasjementet og liker det du leser om oss tar vi gjerne en uforpliktende prat for å se om vi er en god match!

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer - Quality Engineering & AI
jobs.description:
Hos Sogeti tror vi at det beste finnes i hver og en av oss. Gjennom vår felles lidenskap for teknologi, vår AI-drevne tilnærming, vår startup-kultur og vårt fokus på kontinuerlig læring gir vi deg muligheten til å nå ditt fulle potensial og skape verdi for våre kunder. Drevet av et sterkt engasjement for kvalitet og agilitet støtter vi deg gjennom hele karrieren, utvider ditt fotavtrykk og hjelper deg med å bli den beste versjonen av deg selv.

Om rollen

Vi vet at du har mange valgmuligheter i Oslo. Det vet sannsynligvis LinkedIn også.

Derfor skal vi ikke bruke tiden din på å fortelle at vi er «ledende», «innovative» eller «verdens beste arbeidsplass». Det som betyr noe, er om du får interessante utfordringer, dyktige kolleger og muligheten til å utvikle deg videre.

Det får du hos oss.

Som Test Automation Engineer – Quality Engineering & AI hjelper du kundene våre med å bygge kvalitet inn i løsningene fra første dag. Du kombinerer teknisk testkompetanse med moderne automatisering og utforsker hvordan AI kan bidra til bedre kvalitet, raskere leveranser og økt forretningsverdi.

Du vil jobbe tett med utviklere, arkitekter, produkteiere og andre fagpersoner i tverrfaglige team. Samtidig blir du en del av Sogetis fagmiljø innen Quality Engineering & Testing, der vi deler kunnskap, utfordrer etablerte arbeidsformer og utforsker ny teknologi sammen.

Gode ideer kan oppstå mange steder, enten det er i et kundemøte, ved kaffemaskinen eller på en tur i Marka. Det viktigste er at vi deler dem, og gjør noe med dem.

I denne rollen vil du:

Utvikle og vedlikeholde automatiserte tester som en integrert del av moderne utviklings- og leveranseprosesser.
Bidra til kvalitet gjennom hele utviklingsløpet, fra krav og design til produksjonssetting.
Jobbe med CI/CD, DevOps og kontinuerlig testing i smidige team.
Ta i bruk moderne testverktøy og AI-støttede arbeidsformer for å styrke kvalitet og effektivitet.
Rådgi kunder og bidra til å etablere gode test- og kvalitetsprosesser.

Din profil

Du har erfaring med testautomatisering, teknisk testing, kvalitetssikring eller systemutvikling.
Du har god programmeringsforståelse og bruker kode som et naturlig verktøy i arbeidet ditt.
Du har erfaring fra konsulentvirksomhet og/eller andre kundenære leveransemiljøer.
Du har erfaring fra smidige utviklingsprosjekter og gjerne DevOps-orienterte leveransemiljøer.
Du kommuniserer godt med både tekniske og forretningsmessige interessenter.

Vi blir ekstra nysgjerrige dersom du:

Har erfaring med Playwright, Cypress, Selenium eller tilsvarende verktøy og rammeverk.
Har erfaring med Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira eller tilsvarende plattformer.
Har erfaring med API-testing og integrasjon av automatiserte tester i CI/CD.
Har ISTQB-sertifisering eller andre relevante faglige sertifiseringer.
Har erfaring med teknisk rådgivning og direkte samarbeid med kunder.

AI og moderne kvalitetsarbeid

For noen er AI fortsatt et eksperiment. For andre har det allerede blitt en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen.

Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig på hvordan AI kan brukes til å utvikle bedre tester, effektivisere arbeidsprosesser, og skape mer verdi i kundeprosjekter.

For kandidater på seniornivå forventer vi at du bruker relevante AI-verktøy i arbeidshverdagen og kan vise til konkrete eksempler på hvordan dette har forbedret kvalitet, produktivitet eller leveranser. Det kan for eksempel være innen testdesign, generering av testdata, testautomatisering, dokumentasjon, feilanalyse eller kodeutvikling.

For kandidater på lead-nivå forventer vi i tillegg at du kan etablere gode arbeidsformer, veilede kolleger og hjelpe kunder med å identifisere områder der AI og automatisering kan gi målbare kvalitetsforbedringer.

Hvorfor vi tror du vil trives hos oss

Du blir en del av et sterkt fagmiljø innen Quality Engineering & Testing i Oslo.
Du får arbeide med komplekse løsninger og varierte problemstillinger i både privat og offentlig sektor.
Du får utvikle deg gjennom faglige fellesskap, sertifiseringer og praktisk erfaring.
Du får kombinere lokal nærhet med tilgang til Capgemini-konsernets globale kompetanse og partnernettverk.
Du blir en del av et miljø som vet at den beste ideen ikke nødvendigvis kommer fra personen med høyest tittel, eller fra det lengste møtet.

Søknad

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, hører vi gjerne fra deg.

Vi vet selvfølgelig at de beste kandidatene ikke alltid krysser av på alle punkter. Hvis du har en sterk interesse for kvalitet, teknologi og kontinuerlig læring, og kjenner deg igjen i deler av rollen, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

De fleste av oss matcher jo tross alt ikke 100 prosent med vår egen LinkedIn-profil heller.

Please note that all candidates must be fluent in Norwegian.

Som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess vil identitetsverifisering bli gjennomført ved kontroll av ID-kort, og bakgrunnssjekker kan utføres ved behov.

Om Sogeti

Sogeti, en del av Capgemini Group, gjør teknologi enkelt og verdiskapende. Vi er spesialister på AI-drevne løsninger innen Quality Engineering & Testing, data og cloud, og vi omsetter raskt ideer til handling. Sogeti leverer konkrete resultater, hjelper organisasjoner med å innovere med trygghet og skaper verdi fra dag én. Vi er agile, hurtige og drar nytte av sterke partnerskap.

Våre lokale team jobber side om side med kundene våre og bygger nære relasjoner ved å forstå deres virkelighet. Sammen med Capgemini-konsernets globale styrke og bransjeekspertise skaper vi skalerbare resultater.

Sogeti Norge har 150 ansatte på fem lokasjoner: Oslo, Bergen, Sandefjord, Stavanger og Trondheim. Selskapet er ledende på Quality Engineering & Testing i Norge.

Right here. Right now.

jobs.title: Full-stack Developer – Digital Marketing and CRM
jobs.description:
You could call it a Full-stack Developer role - but we’re really looking for someone who enables seamless, personalized customer journeys through smart technology.

The CRM and Marketing Solutions unit at If P&C Insurance is advancing its capabilities in data driven marketing and supporting a digital first strategy. To create customer-centric solutions in this area we utilize many data sources and turn them into event-driven personalized solutions with high business impact.

We want to offer our customers personalized journeys driven by important life events. You will have a key role in making this happen.

About The Role

As a Full-stack Developer, you will be developing APIs, integrations and applications to enable us to communicate with leads and customers in a safe and secure way and ensure that If can reach out in any channel through our new Bloomreach Engagement CDP platform and transform data into personalized customer journeys. You’ll join an easy-going Nordic team of developers who make this happen and have fun while doing it.

You’ll develop B2C and B2B integrations solutions in .Net and C# in Azure Cloud and connect them to our omni-channel CRM touchpoints (email, SMS, web, CX, app, chat and marketing channels) and first party data sources so we can communicate with leads, partners and customers. This includes development and integration to CRM data sources both in Azure, on-premise and to partners via APIs, reliable and asynchronous messaging, and various other channels of data communication. You will practice Agile and DevOps in your day-to-day life.

We offer

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits

About The Team

We’re a Nordic team of highly motivated developers who are passionate about serving customers with timely, personalized communications to help them live a worry-free life and insure what is most dear to them. We work closely with business stakeholders to make this happen and value common Agile DevOps principles with CI/CD so we can continuously deploy value to clients.

We promote continuous tech nurturing, certifications and learning including hackathons both within our team and together with our partners at Microsoft, Bloomreach and Google. We love experimentation and constantly follow new technology to create better solutions.

Who are you?

You’re passionate about solution development in Azure
and have a solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming
using .NET
and C#
.

You Bring

Strong experience with .NET, C#, and Object-Oriented Programming
Experience developing solutions in Azure Cloud
Proficiency in REST APIs, microservices, and message-based architectures
Solid knowledge of Azure data storage (SQL Server, CosmosDB, Azure Storage)
Awareness of Information security and protecting our customers’ integrity (GDPR)
Bonus: Experience with React for UI development

You Also Have

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
Excellent communication skills in English
Proven experience in application and software development

Application Deadline
: Screening and interviewing will be conducted on a rolling basis, however, application deadline is October 16, 2026

Espoo or Turku (Finland), Stockholm (Sweden)

Occasional travel within the Nordics

Start:
As soon as possible or by agreement

For more information, please contact Santiago Varela, Chapter Lead MarTech Fullstack Development, santiago.varela@if.no.

Background checks for this position will be done in accordance with the law in the country of employment.

We look forward to your application!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software-as-a-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high-performance computing calculation engine in the back-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.

We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers. 

What You Will Be Responsible For

Build solutions: collaborate closely with your team, Product Managers, Architects, peers and end-users to deliver high-quality, secure and valuable solutions in the Performance Product Area.
Contribute across the entire development lifecycle - from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.
Coordinate and execute on development and maintenance of the investment performance solution in collaboration with product owners and other teams.
Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.
You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.

What We Are Looking For 

Solid knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework, and object-oriented design principles.
Experience with APIs.
Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).
Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.
You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance & attribution and investment-related instruments.
You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.
You are enthusiastic about building state-of-the-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.
Curiosity and adaptability to learn in-house tools and frameworks - including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).
You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.
You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.
If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.

What Is It Like To Work Here

SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys. 

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
Inclusive and diverse company culture
Pension and health benefits and bonus
Work-life balance – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.   

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Who We Are

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.  

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. 

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at bygge løsninger, der gør en forskel for både medlemmer og kolleger?
Hos LB Forsikring får du et job med faglig substans, fleksibilitet og ordentlige vilkår. Vi er et medlemsejet fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden – og hvor vi arbejder for at gøre forsikring mere enkel og tryg for vores medlemmer.

Lyder de her opgaver som noget for dig?

I Digital Enablement bygger og vedligeholder vi digitale løsninger til vores medlemmer. Vi er i gang med at udvikle vores teknologiske fundament mod en mere modulær og kanalagnostisk arkitektur med headless Sitecore CMS. Derfor søger vi en Senior Backend Developer, der vil arbejde i et miljø, hvor vi refaktorerer løbende, mens vi leverer nye features.

Dine væsentligste opgaver i stillingen vil være:
Designe, udvikle og drifte backend-services og API'er i C# og ASP.NET Core med fokus på sikkerhed, performance, observability og robust drift
Designe og integrere API'er med tydelige kontrakter, herunder OpenAPI/Swagger samt integrationer via REST, GraphQL og SOAP
Sikre høj kodekvalitet gennem kodereviews, automatiserede tests og løsninger, der er testbare og robuste
Arbejde med moderne autentifikation, adgangsstyring, containerisering og cloud native-principper ved hjælp af relevante teknologier og værktøjer
Bidrage til arkitektur, løsningsdesign og fælles tekniske mønstre med afsæt i principper som DDD, OOP og design patterns
Facilitere tekniske afklaringer og understøtte vidensdeling på tværs af teamet

Du får ansvar i takt med din erfaring og interesse. Du behøver ikke komme som færdig teknisk frontfigur. Det vigtigste er, at du har et solidt fagligt fundament, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med teamet.

Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?

Vi ønsker, at du trives, og at vi når vores mål sammen. Derfor kigger vi blandt andet på, om du har følgende faglige og personlige kompetencer til jobbet:

Har solid erfaring med C#, ASP.NET Core og moderne .NET
Har flere års erfaring med softwareudvikling og bringer teknisk modenhed, læringsevne og god dømmekraft i spil
Ser mønstre på tværs af systemer og arbejder med modulært softwaredesign, arkitekturprincipper og skalerbare løsninger
Deltager aktivt i tekniske afklaringer, tager ansvar for at skabe klarhed og bidrager konstruktivt, også når der ikke findes ét rigtigt svar
Har erfaring med sikkerhed, autentifikation, API-design samt driftbare og cloud native-løsninger, der kan monitoreres, fejlsøges og drives sikkert
Arbejder selvstændigt med komplekse opgaver, deler din viden og tager ansvar for fælles resultater
Trives i agile teams, bidrager til psykologisk tryghed og gode samarbejdsrelationer, og motiveres af både at videreudvikle eksisterende løsninger og at opbygge nye platforme
Behersker dansk som arbejdssprog, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Det er en fordel, hvis du også:

Har erfaring med API-udvikling, herunder OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, OpenAPI/Swagger samt værktøjer til test og virtualisering af integrationer
Har arbejdet med Docker og moderne distribuerede applikationer, fx .NET Aspire eller lignende teknologier
Kender til observability gennem OpenTelemetry, tracing, metrics og struktureret logging

Du behøver ikke at mestre hele vores teknologistak fra dag ét. Det vigtigste er, at du har et solidt software engineering-fundament, en stærk datalogisk værktøjskasse og interesse for at arbejde professionelt med design, nyudvikling, refaktorering og langsigtet kvalitet, og at du har lyst til at skabe gode løsninger sammen med andre.

Vi har spurgt tre af dine kommende kolleger om, hvordan de oplever LB

”Vores arbejde handler ofte om fakta, systemer og teknisk problemløsning. Men det kræver også sans for forretningen og for andre, når vi skal vælge, hvad vi løser først – og hvor langt vi går.”

”Vi kan godt lide hinanden, vil gerne hinanden og er der for hinanden. Sådan skal det være at gå på arbejde. LB er et fællesskab – både i ens eget team og på tværs af huset.”

”Det giver energi at se formålet med det, vi laver. Der er substans i jobbet, når de løsninger, du arbejder på, bliver brugt af andre – uanset om det er digital selvbetjening til medlemmerne, dokumenthåndtering til kollegerne eller noget helt tredje.”

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: .NET-udvikler til Product Engineering
jobs.location: Brøndby Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Vi søger en backend-udvikler til Product Engineering, der har lyst til at være med fra bunden – og som samtidig kan bygge løsninger, der holder, når belastningen topper.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor app og backend arbejder som ét hold. Her er der kort fra idé til kode, og du får mandat til at træffe de arkitekturvalg, der skal bære os de næste mange år.

Om jobbet

Som .NET-udvikler sidder du tæt på både app-udviklerne, produktet og forretningen. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

Designe og udvikle skalerbare, sikre og hurtige API’er i C# og moderne .NET
Bygge det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser
Sikre fremdrift i app-teamet med mock-API’er og prototyper, mens den robuste løsning modnes
Bruge moderne AI-kodeværktøjer til at effektivisere boilerplate, test og optimering
Sikre driftssikkerhed og performance i løsninger, der skal klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du genkender dig selv i flere af nedenstående punkter:

Dyb .NET-ekspertise: Du er en stærk håndværker i C# og moderne .NET, og du forstår at bygge skalerbare, sikre og lynhurtige API’er.
Frontend-empati: Du forstår, at dit API er fundamentet for app-oplevelsen. Du tænker over latency og smarte payloads og bygger API’er, der gør livet let og hurtigt for den iOS-udvikler, der skal konsumere dem.
Pragmatisk fremdrift: Du kender vigtigheden af at sikre fremdrift for dine aftagere. Du leverer hurtigt mock-API’er og prototyper, der sikrer fremdrift, mens du bygger den langsigtede og robuste arkitektur under kølerhjelmen.
Agentic AI-kompetence: Du har praktisk erfaring med – eller stor nysgerrighed for – at udnytte agentic workflows, prompt engineering og AI-værktøjer til at accelerere din kode- og udviklingsproces.
Product Engineer-mindset: Du tænker som en Product Engineer. Du koder ikke bare kravspecifikationer, men engagerer dig i brugerrejsen og forretningsværdien.

Om Product Engineering

Product Engineering er produktfokuseret, eksekverende, samarbejdsorienteret, autonom og ambitiøs. Vi bygger for brugeren frem for systemets skyld, vi arbejder som ét team på tværs af app og backend, og vi har mandatet til selv at træffe de rigtige arkitekturvalg. Ambitionen er driftssikre løsninger, der kan håndtere massiv skala.

Hvorfor Danske Spil?

Hos Danske Spil får du en ret unik mulighed: startup-viben ved at være med til at bygge et nyt, stærkt in-house app-udviklingsmiljø op fra bunden – men med skalaen, tyngden og volumen fra en af Danmarks største digitale forretninger.

Som backend-udvikler i Product Engineering bliver du ikke gemt væk i en silo. Du sidder helt tæt på app-udviklerne og forretningen og får direkte indflydelse på det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser. Du arbejder agilt og autonomt med moderne, AI-støttede værktøjer. Det er den perfekte legeplads, hvis du motiveres af at bygge API’er, der både kræver høj fart og innovation i hverdagen, og som samtidig skal kunne klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger uden at blinke.

Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?

Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 9. oktober 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Persson på jepe@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

Til glæde og til gavn

Du kender sikkert vores navn og nogle af vores spil. Men ved du også, hvordan Danske Spil er til glæde og til gavn for hele Danmark?

Vi er markedsleder inden for lotteri, sportsspil og casino i Danmark – og det er staten og de store idrætsforeninger, DGI og DIF, der ejer Danske Spil. Med andre ord ejer vi alle sammen Danske Spil.

Og med det ejerskab følger et særligt ansvar. Et ansvar for at finansiere det idræts-, kultur- og foreningsliv, vi er rundet af. Og et ansvar for at modarbejde spilafhængighed og sørge for, at det hele går ordentligt til.

Vores historie begyndte i 1948, da 20.000 idrætsfolk demonstrerede på Rådhuspladsen for en ny lov, som gav sporten del i overskuddet fra væddemål. Året efter blev Danske Spil grundlagt – og siden har vi hvert år sendt hele vores overskud tilbage til fællesskabet. I 2024 betød det hele 1,8 milliarder til idræt, kultur og foreningsliv i Danmark - og 3,28 milliarder i samlet samfundsbidrag.

Hvert år spiller mere end 1,9 millioner danskere hos os – online eller hos en af vores 3.700 forhandlere. Og vi er knap 500 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder med at balancere konkurrencedygtighed og ansvarlighed. For vi er hele Danmarks spilleselskab – til glæde og til gavn

Vi udvikler selv en stor del af vores løsninger og følger dem fra udvikling til drift og videreudvikling. Derfor søger vi dig, der både er en stærk fullstack-udvikler og kan tage teknisk ansvar for en løsning - fra afklaring og løsningsbeskrivelse til udvikling og implementering.
