Who We Are
At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.
We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.
We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.
Our Values
If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.
Who You Are
You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You have demonstrated the ability to build, deploy, and maintain large-scale, complex applications. You care more about solutions and impacting the customer experience than using a particular tool or framework.
About the role:

You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.
This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.
Responsibilities:

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed.

You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded.

You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset.

You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals.

You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs.

While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.

Qualifications
5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments

Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

At PepsiCo International dCommerce team, we are building the next generation of innovative products and capabilities using emerging technologies to accelerate our business and gain back share. While tied closely to broader PepsiCo, the dCommerce group has a unique start-up feel and defined values that embrace a more entrepreneurial mindset.

We are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to guide the technical direction of our engineering organization as we scale. From evolving our data platform to transitioning to software, from BI tooling into a full application and AI for BI, you'll lead architecture and design reviews, define integration approaches with wider PepsiCo capabilities, and ensure we build coherently across Data Engineering, BI Engineering, and Product Engineering.

This is a role for someone who wants to build the blueprint, not just inherit one. You'll partner with Engineering Managers to make technology choices that balance innovation with pragmatism, navigate platform governance to unblock delivery, and ensure what we build today supports where we're heading. If you want to shape the technical future of a scaling digital commerce capability not just review other people's designs - this is that opportunity.

Responsibilities

Architecture and Design Oversight

Define and maintain reference architectures for dComm capabilities from data platform through to user-facing applications

Participate in creating the the architectural runway in collaboration with Platform team by identifying foundational investments needed to support future capabilities

Platform and Integration Strategy

Partner with DTX Core Platform Team to ensure dComm needs are represented in platform decisions
Navigate platform governance, submit requests, advocate for international requirements, ensure dComm isn't blocked by platform constraints
Advise on AI for BI evolution

Technical Leadership

Provide architectural guidance on complex cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams
Review and challenge technical designs to ensure they meet non-functional requirements (performance, security, maintainability)

Standards and Governance

Define and maintain software architecture standards for dComm: API design, service boundaries, security patterns, deployment approaches
Ensure alignment with wider PepsiCo technology standards while advocating for dComm-specific needs
Create and maintain architecture documentation, decision records, and design artefacts
Guide Engineering Managers on architectural trade-offs and help them make informed decisions

Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary architectural interface between dComm and DTX Core Platform Team
Collaborate with Data Architect to ensure end-to-end coherence across data and application layers

Qualifications

Comfortable operating in a matrix environment across dComm, DTX Platform, and enterprise functions

What makes us different?

Hybrid work model: combination of remote and collaborative office experience to enable innovation
Entrepreneurial environment in leading international company
Professional growth possibilities & learning opportunities
Variety of benefits to support your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing
Volunteering opportunities to help external communities

We believe that culture should be at the cornerstone of everything we do at PepsiCo. We are agile, innovative and not afraid of failure. We want our team to come to work every day excited to explore new ways to bring enjoyment, refreshment and fun to the world.

PepsiCo Positive (pep+) is the future of our organization – a strategic end-to-end transformation, with sustainability at the center of how we will create growth and value by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for the planet and people.

jobs.description:
Who we are 
We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your Mission

We're looking for a Frontend QA Engineering Intern to support our mission of delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing automated solutions. In this role, you’ll work alongside experienced QA engineers and developers to test new features, identify issues, and ensure the best possible user experience from the UI level.

Your focus will be on frontend testing across key example projects, such as operational workflows, AI integrations, and low-code automation tools. Leveraging modern low-code platforms like Appian and UiPath, your curiosity, attention to detail, and understanding of software quality principles will be key in maintaining Bitpanda’s standards of excellence, innovation, and operational scalability.

What You’ll Do

Execute Frontend Testing:

Support QA in ensuring product quality, reliability, and performance through structured frontend testing, validating end-to-end user journeys, AI integrations, and automated business processes.
Collaborate Across Teams:

Work closely with developers, Business Analysts, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements, document test cases, identify potential quality risks early in the development cycle and support UAT cycles.
Test Low-Code Test Automation:

Design, execute, and maintain frontend test cases using low-code automation tools such as Appian and UiPath, ensuring complete alignment with product and business objectives.
Monitor & Track Bugs:

Assist in monitoring, reporting, and tracking defects using standard QA tools and workflows (Jira), contributing clear visual proofs and step-by-step reproduction details for efficient issue resolution.
Drive Quality in Agile Sprints:

Participate actively in sprint planning and review meetings, sharing insights to enhance frontend test coverage and drive a culture of quality across teams.

Who You Are
Frontend & Quality Mindset:

Detail-oriented and proactive, with a keen interest in user experience, UI workflows, and ensuring the overall reliability of software products.
Low-Code & Automation Curious:

Familiar with core testing concepts (manual testing, test automation, agile methodologies) and eager to gain hands-on experience with low-code platforms like Appian and UiPath.
Methodical Problem-Solver:

Possess a strong analytical mindset to test beyond happy paths, naturally exploring boundary limits, non-numeric edge cases, and unexpected UI behaviors.
Structured Communicator:

Excellent collaborator able to document findings clearly, articulate technical issues with concrete real-world examples, and contribute to continuous team improvement.
Relevant Academic Background:

Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (preferred but not required).

What’s in it for you
Flexibility to work where you thrive

– Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
Reward for your impact

– Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
Support for your mental wellbeing

– Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
Time to recharge

– On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
Continuous learning and growth

– Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
Exclusive perks and rewards

– Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
Support during life milestones

Fuel and focus on-site

Recognition for your contributions

– Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
Show your Bitpanda pride

– Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
Connect and celebrate with your team

– Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.
Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. * These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
Valsea - Where Innovation Meets Entertainment

At Valsea, we’re shaping the future of entertainment with immersive, engaging experiences that captivate players worldwide. Based in sunny Marbella, Spain, our vibrant open-space office is home to an international team of developers, marketers, product owners, and much more.

Valsea operates a leading scalable technology platform, 100% owned by us. This gives us the freedom to deliver results fast. We integrate selected outside companies into our ecosystem to ensure we provide fresh and vibrant products for our customers.

We work in a fast-paced environment, creating new brands, maintaining and improving our tech stack, launching leading acquisition and retention campaigns, and developing fresh features. Our ethos is simple - be best-in-class in everything we do.

Despite our rapid growth, Valsea still has that exciting start-up feel. We embrace a hybrid working model to balance professional growth with personal well-being. With a dynamic work environment, attractive salary, and a culture that thrives on collaboration, our power is our people.

We provide company laptops and other things you may need to work comfortably. Remote workers are always invited to our annual company trip and other team events. Ready to be part of something exciting?

What are we looking for now?

A Staff-level engineer who has done this before: someone who can walk into a mature, high-scale platform, understand where AI genuinely moves the needle versus where it's just noise, and lead the engineering work to get it done. You're comfortable being the most senior technical voice in the room, but you'd rather be pairing with an engineer on a gnarly integration than sitting in a strategy deck all day. You think in systems, not scripts: production reliability, data quality, and security aren't afterthoughts to you, they're the job.

This isn't a research role. It's a build role, with the freedom and seniority to also set direction.

What You'll Do

Own the technical strategy and roadmap for AI adoption across Valsea's product, platform, and internal tooling, grounded in what's actually feasible on our stack, not slideware.
Architect and lead the delivery of AI-powered capabilities into our Scala/Go/Kafka backend, from recommendation and personalisation to support/fraud/risk signals, agentic automation, and internal developer tooling.
Set the vision and roadmap for agentic QA automation (using AI agents to expand test coverage, catch regressions earlier, and reduce manual QA load) and for AI-accelerated support and incident response that cuts time-to-detect and time-to-resolve.
Introduce AI tooling at the root of our SDLC pipelines (GitHub/GitLab: code review, testing, deployment gates), so AI assistance is built into how the team ships, not bolted on afterward.
Evaluate and integrate LLM and ML infrastructure (self-hosted and API-based), making pragmatic build-vs-buy calls that respect our scale, latency, and cost constraints.
Set Product Development standards for how AI features get designed, tested, monitored, and rolled back. Model-driven systems should meet the same rigour as any other production service.
Partner directly with Engineering leadership, Product, and Data to identify where AI creates real player or business value, and turn that into a delivery plan.
Act as a technical multiplier: mentor senior and mid-level engineers and managers, run design reviews, and raise the technical bar for how the wider team thinks about AI-assisted and AI-driven systems.
Stay hands-on: prototype fast, get into the codebase, and unblock hard integration and performance problems yourself when it matters.

What You'll Bring

5+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in the JVM/Scala ecosystem (or a comparably strong background in a statically-typed, distributed-systems-heavy language) plus proven Staff/Principal-level scope: setting technical direction, not just executing it.
Hands-on experience shipping AI/ML-powered features into production at real scale, with real users: LLM integration, recommendation systems, applied ML, or agentic infrastructure.
Deep comfort with event-driven, distributed architectures (Akka/Pekko, Kafka or equivalent); you understand the failure modes, not just the happy path.
Strong, hands-on experience with distributed systems and container orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, and the operational patterns that come with running them at scale.
A track record of making sound build-vs-buy and platform decisions, including around cost, latency, data privacy, and vendor risk for AI systems specifically.
Product-minded: you think in terms of player impact and business outcomes, not just technical elegance.
A strong communicator who can move fluidly between a whiteboard architecture discussion with engineers and a plain-language case for leadership.
You thrive in ambiguity: this role starts with a mandate, not a spec, and you'll help write the spec.
Proficiency in professional-level English communication, written and verbal.

Nice To Have

Please note, these aren't requirements, just things we think would be particularly valuable. If anything or everything here doesn't apply to you, please don't let that put you off applying.

Good domain knowledge of entertainment or another regulated, high-throughput consumer platform is recommended.
Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
Background running or scaling self-hosted AI/LLM infrastructure and observability.
Exposure to fraud detection, risk scoring, or trust & safety systems.
Experience introducing AI tooling into an engineering organization's own workflows (dev tooling, code review, incident response), not just into the product.
Modern MLOps/LLMOps practices and tooling.

What We Offer

Hybrid working model from our office in Marbella (3 days/week) or fully remote (EU)
Innovative international company that uses cutting-edge tech equipment
Collaborative teams and agile multicultural environment
Competitive salary with flexible working hours
23 paid vacation days + public holidays
Private health insurance for you and your family
Free Online English/Spanish lessons
Corporate events throughout the year
Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities

In-office Perks Such As

Daily breakfast and freshly cooked lunch 3 days a week
50% discount on personal training sessions and physiotherapy sessions
Games room, full kitchen with hot drinks, fruit, soft drinks
Gym, massage room and much more

At Valsea, we want diversity and inclusion in an environment where unique perspectives and new talents thrive. Join us in creating a workplace where everyone can shine and contribute to our collective success. Protecting your privacy and data security is a longstanding top priority for Valsea. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://valsea.teamtailor.com/data-privacy) to learn more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

We’re a diverse team with great people from across the world. This position is available both as a hybrid position in Marbella (Spain) or as a fully remote position from inside the EU. Please note that we are unable to sponsor work visas outside the EU.

jobs.title: Domain Engineer
jobs.description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The ERP Engineering Team at Shine

We're a fast-growing engineering team on a mission to build the best ERP for Small Businesses in Europe. We work in a domain-based structure, where each domain has real ownership over its area — from architecture to quality and technical roadmap.

Your Role as a Domain Engineer

As a Domain Engineer, you're the technical reference for the product: you define architecture direction, ensure engineering standards, and work closely with team managers and Senior Engineers to make sure technical decisions serve the business goals. This is a senior IC role, focused on cross-cutting technical impact, not people management.

We're modernizing our stack and expanding into new markets, which means real problems around scale, multi-tenancy, and domain complexity — not greenfield, but not paralyzing legacy either.

What You'll Do

Own the target architecture of your domain and the realistic path to get there.
Ensure reliability, scalability, security, and compliance are design constraints from day one, not afterthoughts.
Maintain living architecture documentation (C4 model diagrams, ADRs) as part of the engineering workflow.
Set and calibrate design review thresholds, delegating to senior engineers as their judgment grows.
Spend roughly half your time embedded with engineering teams, and half on cross-engineering work — standards, the Golden Path, and the Architecture Forum.
Grow the architectural judgment of senior engineers, so fewer decisions need to come through you over time.
Partner with Engineering Directors, Engineering Managers, and Product to surface technical constraints and trade-offs with clarity.

📍 Job located in Porto with possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You

Scalable systems experience: You have significant hands-on experience designing and evolving systems at scale, ideally within multi-tenant SaaS or platform environments.
Architectural ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of architecture decisions. You ensure your reasoning is well-documented so others can easily understand the context and trade-offs later.
Influence without authority: You are comfortable operating with technical authority and guiding direction without needing formal line-management authority.
Cross-functional communication: You can translate complex technical trade-offs into clear, legible concepts for Product managers and business leadership.
Empowerment over centralization: You have a genuine interest in developing other engineers' judgment rather than centralizing decision-making around yourself.
Tech stack & domain experience: You are comfortable with .NET, Angular, SQL Server, Azure, and modern CI/CD practices. Experience with financial, accounting, or ERP systems—as well as European regulatory compliance—is a strong differentiator.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ A 45' first call with Marc (Talent Acquisition Specialist) to get to know you better and share more about Ageras.

2️⃣ A 90' Technical Interview with one of our Domain Engineers to dive into Architecture and Coding topics

3️⃣ A 45' Manager interview with Rui (Senior Engineering Manager) to dive deeper into our set up.

4️⃣ A 60' Practical Assessment with one of our Domain Engineer.

Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead architecture design, drive technology decisions, and co-create innovative products while mentoring clients to adopt Agile practices and engineering excellence. Your work will have a lasting impact beyond the products you build. By collaborating with client leadership, you will influence their digital strategies, help scale their engineering cultures, and enable them to achieve sustainable growth. Lead Azure Databricks platform implementation and evolution
Define enterprise data, analytics, ML and AI platform standards and best practices
Design Lakehouse and Medallion architectures

Define patterns for operationalizing machine learning models from development through production
Define standards for model lifecycle management, deployment and monitoring on the platform
Drive the adoption and evolution of MLflow and related ML lifecycle capabilities

Establish architectural patterns for batch and real-time model inference and model serving
Drive platform scalability, reliability, observability and performance
Lead Infrastructure as Code adoption
Design CI/CD standards and patterns for data, ML and platform components
Drive automation across data and machine learning solution lifecycles
Mentor engineering teams and provide technical leadership
Collaborate with Data Scientists on productionization patterns and technical requirements for ML and AI solutions

7+ years of experience in Data Engineering, ML Engineering, Cloud Platform Engineering, or a related field.

Experience with enterprise data governance and metadata management platforms such as Unity Catalog or Microsoft Purview.

Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Profil / Mission

L’IA Engineer / Développeur est responsable de la conception, du développement et de l’industrialisation de solutions d’intelligence artificielle, avec un accent sur l’IA générative (GenAI) et les cas d’usage enterprise (assistants, RAG, automatisation, analyse de documents, etc.).

Le choix, la mise en œuvre et l’optimisation de modèles d’IA (LLM, modèles de vision, embeddings, etc.) en fonction des cas d’usage et des contraintes (coût, latence, confidentialité, conformité)
La conception et l’optimisation d’architectures RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) : ingestion, chunking, embeddings, bases vectorielles, stratégies de retrieval, évaluation de la qualité des réponses
La gestion des pipelines de données : collecte, nettoyage, transformation, enrichment, versioning et gouvernance des données utilisées pour l’IA
L’ingénierie de prompts et l’orchestration de flux d’IA (multi-agents, tool calling, function calling, guardrails, filtrage, modération)
L’intégration de l’IA dans les applications et SI existants (APIs, microservices, événements, interfaces utilisateurs)
La contribution au déploiement de solutions IA dans des environnements cloud sécurisés (AWS, Azure, GCP), avec une attention particulière à la sécurité, la confidentialité et la conformité (RGPD, politiques internes)
La mise en place de pratiques MLOps / LLMOps : monitoring des modèles et des prompts, gestion des versions, tests, re-training / fine-tuning, gestion des coûts et de la performance
La collaboration avec les équipes métier, data, produit et sécurité pour transformer des besoins business en solutions IA robustes et mesurables

Expérience en CI/CD et automatisation (Dev / Data / IA) : GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.
Expérience en conception et implémentation d’API REST / GraphQL et d’intégrations événementielles (Kafka, Pub/Sub, etc.)
Expérience en prompt engineering, evaluation de prompts, guardrails, sécurité des LLM (injection, data leakage, PII, etc.)

new_jobs.title: Platform (.NET/C#) Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Leadature
Leadature is a B2B event-technology platform, operating since 2008, with Fortune 500 clients and a 17-year track record. We run on-site intelligence for live events: badge scanning, lead capture and retrieval, session and booth tracking, badge printing, RFID, AI enrichment, and post-event reporting. We serve both sides of an event – the organizer running the show and the exhibitors on the floor.
We are a small, senior, fully distributed team. Decisions are fast and we work dynamically.

Why this role exists
Our platform works and it delivers for enterprise clients and SMBs, and has done for years. Over time it inherited a lot of  per-client customisations, product direction is currently split across several owners, which means we build reactively and our roadmap is decided by whichever event is next.
We are deciding now how much of it to modernise and how much to rebuild. Whoever takes this role will be one of a small number of people who genuinely understand how the product works – and central to what we build next.
If you like inheriting a real system with real clients on it, and turning manual work into product, this is that job. If you want greenfield only, it isn't.

What you will do
Support our clients

Be the technical voice in client conversations, alongside customer success and sales
Own client technical issues end to end — troubleshooting, data exports, configuration questions — with a client waiting
Run and improve the enrichment delivery for client events
Support live events. Events do not respect office hours, and during a show you will be reachable and responsive
Travel to a small number of client events a year to see the product in the environment it runs in

Build and customise

Ship the customisations enterprise clients ask for, hands-on
Stand up client registration and event pages quickly – we are comfortable with AI-assisted development where it gets a working thing in front of a client faster
Look for the places where AI removes manual work altogether — our enrichment pipeline, badge data cleanup, and reporting are all still done by hand and should not be
Improve the enrichment pipeline, which we currently run largely by hand

Make the knowledge transferable

Document how the platform works – campaign structures, data models, integrations, exports
Replace tribal knowledge with automation, tooling and sane technical governance
Get us to a point where we can add engineers without a two-month ramp

Support clients directly

Be the technical voice in client conversations, alongside our customer success and sales team
Support live events. Events do not respect office hours, and during a show you will be reachable and responsive
Occasionally travel to client events to see the product in the environment it runs in

Your first 90 days
This is real work waiting, not an onboarding exercise.
Document the campaign architecture – how primary, lookup and vertical campaigns interconnect
Produce a field dictionary for our event data exports, so anyone can pull a clean file
Take ownership of our platform integrations and move them onto proper service accounts
Come back with a prioritised product roadmap and tell us what you would change first

What we are looking for
Must have

Strong .NET / C# engineering, and no fear of a legacy codebase. Our platform is an older ASP.NET application – you should be able to read it, ship into it, and say honestly what is load-bearing and what should be replaced
Fluent in a modern stack too, because that is where we are heading: current .NET (8 or later) with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server or PostgreSQL, React with TypeScript, and containerised deploys with CI/CD. You don't need every one of these, but you should have built and shipped on a current stack recently – not only maintained an old one
Excellent written English, and comfort being in front of enterprise clients
Willingness to be available during live events, including outside normal hours
Genuine AI proficiency, not curiosity. You use coding assistants and agentic tools daily and have opinions about which ones earn their place. You have used LLMs on real data work
Self-direction. Nobody here will manage your calendar

Nice to have

Event technology, ticketing, registration, or conference-tech background. This is a genuine advantage and we will weight it heavily
Experience with badge and registration APIs generally
Data work: reporting, enrichment, moving messy data between systems
Having built something with an LLM in the product itself, not just in your own workflow

Working setup
Fully remote. We work across US and European hours
Contract engagement to start, with scope for it to grow as the platform does
A few events a year might involve travel, fully covered

How we hire
Short screening call
Technical conversation with one of our senior engineers
Test task / a working session on a real problem from our backlog
Final conversation with our CEO

With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.
Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices.

, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work.

Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end delivery of complex features — from architecture through production.

new_jobs.title: Backend & DevOps-konsult (direktuppdrag) - Kollarna.se
new_jobs.description:
På Doktor.se definierar vi om det svenska sjukvårdssystemet genom att göra det mer tillgängligt, smidigt och effektivt, utan att kompromissa med kvalitet eller säkerhet. Vår hybridmodell, som kombinerar fysiska vårdcentraler med moderna digitala lösningar, har gjort oss till den största digitala vårdgivaren i Sverige, med miljontals konsultationer varje år.

Om uppdraget

Vi söker en erfaren Backend- och DevOps-konsult för ett uppdrag hos Kollarna.se, en tjänst som erbjuds av Doktor.se:s dotterbolag Doktor24.se. Vi vill arbeta direkt med dig som konsult, utan mellanhänder.

Uppdraget syftar till att stärka och modernisera Kollarnas infrastruktur i Azure, med fokus på säkerhet, skalbarhet och automatisering. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med Kollarnas utvecklingsteam och driver dina leveranser självständigt mot överenskomna mål.

Vad uppdraget innebär

Uppdraget omfattar följande leveranser:

Genomlysning av nuvarande Azure-miljö och säkerhetsläge, med prioriterade åtgärdsförslag.
Införande av infrastructure as code för befintliga tjänster.
Översyn och förenkling av CI/CD-pipelines i GitHub Actions.
Uppsättning av monitorering och larm, samt översyn av skalbarhet, t.ex. databaser och cachning (Redis).
Rådgivning i design- och arkitekturfrågor som rör leveranserna ovan.
Dokumentation och överlämning till teamet vid uppdragets slut.

Vem vi söker

Du har gärna 5 år eller mer som backendutvecklare med erfarenhet av DevOps, som infrastrukturingenjör eller i liknande roll, framför allt i Azure-miljöer (erfarenhet av AWS är meriterande). Kollarnas backend är skriven i C# .NET och frontend i TypeScript/React. Erfarenhet av TypeScript och/eller Python är meriterande.

Du kan drifta Azure-tjänster med hjälp av exempelvis GitHub Actions, har god erfarenhet av databaser och SQL, framför allt MS SQL, och vet hur man bäst utnyttjar Azure-tjänster och sätter upp exempelvis Redis. Du har erfarenhet av att sätta upp och underhålla monitorering, tänker säkerhet först och har gedigen kunskap om hur man skyddar infrastruktur mot intrång.

Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

Varför uppdraget är intressant

Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

Uppdragsvillkor

Uppdragsform:
Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

Uppdragslängd:
Enligt överenskommelse.

Omfattning:
40 timmar per vecka.

Start:
Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

Arbetsplats:
Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

Ersättning:
Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

Övrigt:
Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

Var med och gör skillnad i vården!

Som en del av vår urvalsprocess genomför vi ID-kontroll och begär utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Vi söker konsulter som vill arbeta direkt med oss och ber därför vänligt men bestämt att konsultmäklare, konsultbolag och rekryteringsföretag avstår från att kontakta oss.

På Doktor.Se vill vi göra saker annorlunda. Vi vill utmana och förändra en hel bransch. Allt började med en idé om att det måste gå att skapa en vårdlösning som är bättre anpassad till vår tid och våra behov. Att det måste gå att få moderna digitala verktyg och traditionell fysisk vård att samverka med utgångspunkt i patientens behov. Och att göra det så att det inte bara blir tillgängligt för våra patienter utan också bidrar till att utveckla det sätt som vård erbjuds på idag. För oss alla. Det här är faktiskt vad vi gör idag. Men vi är långt ifrån klara och är ute på en spännande förändringsresa. Där kan du få vara med och bidra.

new_jobs.description:
Senior Software Developer - Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U)

Do you want to make the world a safer place while being part of a team that truly values experience and collaboration?

Would you like to join a global and technically skilled team that plays an essential role in Verisure’s success?

The platform organisation in Malmö develops and operates the software that underpins Verisure's alarm and smart home systems. We are responsible for the services that keep millions of connected devices online, upgradeable, and traceable, from the moment a device is manufactured until it is returned or decommissioned.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Developer in Platform Utilities & Upgrades (PU&U), you will join a team of around 11 backend engineers building and operating a portfolio of internal platform services. These cover device lifecycle management (factory provisioning, firmware upgrades, SIM management) and internal operator and support tooling used daily by Verisure technicians and administrators. Several of these services run with 24/7 SLA requirements; device provisioning and support tooling are business-critical, always-on parts of the platform.

You will design, build, and operate microservices spanning device lifecycle management, SIM connectivity, firmware/upgrade orchestration, and internal utility tooling. You will work closely with the team's Product Owner, fellow developers, and PU&U's external EMS partners to translate manufacturing and operational requirements into reliable software. You are expected to take technical ownership of parts of the system, contribute to architectural decisions, and mentor less experienced developers.

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation, not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages, spanning millions of connected devices, is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Location:
Malmö (5-minute walk from the Central Station)

Our AI journey

We are in the middle of a practical, progressive AI transformation — not chasing hype, but steadily embedding intelligence into how we build software and how we operate our platform. Our engineering teams are actively adopting AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, and we are rolling out a group-wide AIOps platform (built on AWS Bedrock) that already powers more than 25 use cases across 10+ countries. The device data PU&U manages — spanning millions of connected devices — is one of Verisure's core advantages in developing AI capabilities for detection, maintenance, and device operations. As a senior developer, you will have a voice in how your team adopts these tools, at a pace that makes sense.

Who are you?

We are looking for an experienced backend developer with a strong technical foundation and the confidence to take ownership of complex, business-critical services. You enjoy working in an environment with a long-term technical vision but shifting short-term priorities, and you communicate clearly with both engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders. You take pride in code quality, system reliability, and helping the team improve its ways of working.

Required

Several years of hands-on experience as a backend software developer, ideally in a microservice/distributed systems environment
Solid experience with Java and Spring Boot
Experience with containerised deployment (Docker, Kubernetes)
Fluency in English (verbal and written)

Also, Great If You Have

Experience with message-driven architecture (e.g. RabbitMQ)
Experience with relational databases (e.g. MySQL)
Frontend experience (React/JavaScript) is a plus, though not the core focus of the role
Familiarity with device lifecycle management, IoT connectivity, or hardware/software integration
Experience working in an environment with external hardware/manufacturing partners
AWS experience

About Verisure

Verisure is the leading provider of professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America. As of 31 December 2025, Verisure provides premium monitored alarm services to a portfolio of ~6.2 million families and small businesses across 18 countries, with a team of more than 30,000 colleagues.

For the year ended 31 December 2025, Verisure delivered a strong financial performance: Total Revenue of €3,745 million, Adjusted EBITDA of €1,708 million (46% margin) and Adjusted EBIT of €953 million (25% margin). This performance builds on the Company’s track record of resilient, uninterrupted growth over the long term and highlights the strength of its recurring revenue model.

Verisure is majority owned by Hellman & Friedman LLC, a leading private equity investment firm.

Beginning October 8th, 2025, Verisure is listed in the Nasdaq Stockholm Stock Exchange. With €3.1 billion raised in primary proceeds, this was the largest IPO in Europe since 2022 and the largest in Sweden in over 25 years.

My team and I eagerly await your application! Join us on this journey towards a safer, smarter world. Apply today!

If you have questions regarding this position, please reach out to our Group Senior TA Specialist, Robert Jonasson, at robert.jonasson@verisure.com

Verisure is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We are an international company with offices and colleagues in multiple countries.

We make cargo talk. Why? Because a third of all food and pharma produce is wasted on the way to consumers, and we're out to change that. new_jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Som Senior DevOps Engineer hos Webstep får du muligheten til å jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom utvikling, operations og plattform for noen av de viktigste virksomhetene i Norge. Du får samarbeide med dyktige fagfolk som brenner for teknologi, og du får frihet til å ta ansvar, påvirke beslutninger og bidra til å utvikle fremtidens løsninger.

Vi ser etter deg som vil være med å bygge et av Norges sterkeste fagmiljøer for seniorkonsulenter. Hos oss handler det ikke bare om å levere. Det handler om å skape løsninger som varer, og å gjøre det sammen med folk du trives med.

Vi ønsker at du har:

Minimum 5 års erfaring som DevOps Engineer, eller 3+ års utviklererfaring kombinert med 2+ års DevOps-erfaring
Solid forståelse av nettverk og sikkerhet, logging, varsling og hvordan applikasjoner kommuniserer (REST, messaging services, monitorering og overvåkning)
Erfaring med Infrastructure as Code (IaC) og scripting, gjerne med Terraform, Bicep, eller Ansible.
Hands-on erfaring med containere (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD og minst én av skyplattformene Azure, AWS eller GCP
Erfaring med å sette opp enterprise-løsninger for autentisering og tilgangsstyring (f.eks. GitHub Enterprise), og strukturere arbeidsmetodikk på tvers av team
Du trives med å jobbe tett med kunder, forstår deres behov og bryr deg om at løsningene faktisk fungerer i praksis
Du er god til å forklare komplekse løsninger på en enkel måte, både muntlig og skriftlig, på norsk og engelsk
Sertifiseringer som AZ-305, AZ-400, KCNA eller andre generelle sky/devops-sertifiseringer er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som trives med mange baller i lufta og ad-hoc-styrte dager der ting skjer kontinuerlig. Du er fleksibel, tar initiativ og finner motivasjon i å være den som binder sammen utvikling, operations og plattform.

Du bryr deg om mer enn bare kode og infrastruktur. Du leverer godt, tar initiativ og involverer deg i det som skjer. Enten det er på Slack, et arrangement eller ute hos kunde. Du har høy integritet og vet at ved å dele kunnskap så blir alle bedre. Kanskje liker du å skrive blogger, holde foredrag eller bidra i faggrupper? Hos oss får du muligheten til nettopp det. De beste løsningene skapes tross alt i team der folk utfordrer hverandre og tør å tenke nytt.

Du er kanskje en person som forventer at arbeidsgiver skal stille samme høye krav til seg selv som de gjør til sine ansatte. Du bryr deg om trivsel, faglig utvikling og langsiktig vekst, og ønsker å være en del av et selskap som virkelig investerer i folkene sine.

Hvorfor Webstep?

Webstep er bygget på tanken om at de beste løsningene skapes av folk som har det bra. Derfor investerer vi tungt i både faglig utvikling og sosiale arenaer. Ikke fordi vi må, men fordi vi mener det.

Faglig utvikling på dine premisser

Hos oss får du tilgang til et av bransjens sterkeste fagmiljøer. Vi deler kunnskap på fagkvelder, kompetansehelger og vår årlige fagdag: en intern konferanse der kolleger holder innlegg, vi flyr inn inspirerende keynote-speakers, og det hele avsluttes med fest og sosialt. Fagdagen skjer på en lørdag, slik at du ikke mister lønn for å delta.
Vi deltar på og er sponsorer for konferanser som JavaZone og NDN, og støtter sertifiseringer og kurs som gir mening for deg. Vi har også rollen som faglig fyrtårn! Rollen går på åremål og du blir løftet fram for å representere Webstep faglig, holde foredrag og sitte i vårt nasjonale fagråd. Med andre ord kan du være med å sette Websteps faglige retning!
Brenner du for noe spesifikt? Kanskje du vil starte en faggruppe med fokus på platform engineering, sette opp et hackathon, eller få inn en internasjonal ekspert til å snakke om et tema du er opptatt av? Bare spør. Vi sier sjelden nei til gode initiativ.

En kultur som faktisk fungerer

Vi er ikke bare kollegaer. Vi er folk som kjenner hverandre godt. Gjennom året møtes vi på nyttårsbord, sommerfest, vintertur, høsttur (til utlandet), konsulenttur, lønningspils og bedriftslag som klatring, padel, sjakk og brettspill. Og ja, familien din er velkommen med på flere sosiale sammenkomster i året. Vi tror at når du blir kjent med kollegaene dine utover jobb, bygger vi et sterkere fellesskap.

Vår organisasjonsstruktur er flat og uformell. Vi har ingen lag på lag med ledelse. Konsulentledere har én jobb: å følge opp deg. Ikke rekruttering, ikke salg, ikke ti andre oppgaver, bare deg. Vår CEO sitter på kontoret, er tilgjengelig og har åpen dør. Det er lav terskel for å slå av en prat med hvem som helst, uansett rolle.

Frihet og fleksibilitet

Hos oss får du frihet til å velge prosjekter som passer deg, og fleksibilitet til å legge opp hverdagen din sammen med kunden. Er det greit for kunden, er det greit for Webstep. Vi tror at folk som får frihet, tar ansvar, og det er akkurat sånn vi liker å jobbe.
Du får jobbe med spennende kunder i bransjer som energi, bank og finans, helse, handel og offentlig sektor. Det betyr at du kan bidra til å forme samfunnet, samtidig som du utvikler deg faglig .

Et arbeidsmiljø som investerer i deg

Vi kutter aldri på fag eller sosialt. Vi bruker betydelige ressurser på trivsel, kompetansebygging og på å skape en arbeidsplass der folk faktisk vil være. new_jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer - Quality Engineering & AI
new_jobs.description:
Hos Sogeti tror vi at det beste finnes i hver og en av oss. Gjennom vår felles lidenskap for teknologi, vår AI-drevne tilnærming, vår startup-kultur og vårt fokus på kontinuerlig læring gir vi deg muligheten til å nå ditt fulle potensial og skape verdi for våre kunder. Drevet av et sterkt engasjement for kvalitet og agilitet støtter vi deg gjennom hele karrieren, utvider ditt fotavtrykk og hjelper deg med å bli den beste versjonen av deg selv.

Om rollen

Vi vet at du har mange valgmuligheter i Oslo. Det vet sannsynligvis LinkedIn også.

Derfor skal vi ikke bruke tiden din på å fortelle at vi er «ledende», «innovative» eller «verdens beste arbeidsplass». Det som betyr noe, er om du får interessante utfordringer, dyktige kolleger og muligheten til å utvikle deg videre.

Det får du hos oss.

Som Test Automation Engineer – Quality Engineering & AI hjelper du kundene våre med å bygge kvalitet inn i løsningene fra første dag. Du kombinerer teknisk testkompetanse med moderne automatisering og utforsker hvordan AI kan bidra til bedre kvalitet, raskere leveranser og økt forretningsverdi.

Du vil jobbe tett med utviklere, arkitekter, produkteiere og andre fagpersoner i tverrfaglige team. Samtidig blir du en del av Sogetis fagmiljø innen Quality Engineering & Testing, der vi deler kunnskap, utfordrer etablerte arbeidsformer og utforsker ny teknologi sammen.

Gode ideer kan oppstå mange steder, enten det er i et kundemøte, ved kaffemaskinen eller på en tur i Marka. Det viktigste er at vi deler dem, og gjør noe med dem.

I denne rollen vil du:

Utvikle og vedlikeholde automatiserte tester som en integrert del av moderne utviklings- og leveranseprosesser.
Bidra til kvalitet gjennom hele utviklingsløpet, fra krav og design til produksjonssetting.
Jobbe med CI/CD, DevOps og kontinuerlig testing i smidige team.
Ta i bruk moderne testverktøy og AI-støttede arbeidsformer for å styrke kvalitet og effektivitet.
Rådgi kunder og bidra til å etablere gode test- og kvalitetsprosesser.

Din profil

Du har erfaring med testautomatisering, teknisk testing, kvalitetssikring eller systemutvikling.
Du har god programmeringsforståelse og bruker kode som et naturlig verktøy i arbeidet ditt.
Du har erfaring fra konsulentvirksomhet og/eller andre kundenære leveransemiljøer.
Du har erfaring fra smidige utviklingsprosjekter og gjerne DevOps-orienterte leveransemiljøer.
Du kommuniserer godt med både tekniske og forretningsmessige interessenter.

Vi blir ekstra nysgjerrige dersom du:

Har erfaring med Playwright, Cypress, Selenium eller tilsvarende verktøy og rammeverk.
Har erfaring med Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira eller tilsvarende plattformer.
Har erfaring med API-testing og integrasjon av automatiserte tester i CI/CD.
Har ISTQB-sertifisering eller andre relevante faglige sertifiseringer.
Har erfaring med teknisk rådgivning og direkte samarbeid med kunder.

AI og moderne kvalitetsarbeid

For noen er AI fortsatt et eksperiment. For andre har det allerede blitt en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen.

Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig på hvordan AI kan brukes til å utvikle bedre tester, effektivisere arbeidsprosesser, og skape mer verdi i kundeprosjekter.

For kandidater på seniornivå forventer vi at du bruker relevante AI-verktøy i arbeidshverdagen og kan vise til konkrete eksempler på hvordan dette har forbedret kvalitet, produktivitet eller leveranser. Det kan for eksempel være innen testdesign, generering av testdata, testautomatisering, dokumentasjon, feilanalyse eller kodeutvikling.

For kandidater på lead-nivå forventer vi i tillegg at du kan etablere gode arbeidsformer, veilede kolleger og hjelpe kunder med å identifisere områder der AI og automatisering kan gi målbare kvalitetsforbedringer.

Hvorfor vi tror du vil trives hos oss

Du blir en del av et sterkt fagmiljø innen Quality Engineering & Testing i Oslo.
Du får arbeide med komplekse løsninger og varierte problemstillinger i både privat og offentlig sektor.
Du får utvikle deg gjennom faglige fellesskap, sertifiseringer og praktisk erfaring.
Du får kombinere lokal nærhet med tilgang til Capgemini-konsernets globale kompetanse og partnernettverk.
Du blir en del av et miljø som vet at den beste ideen ikke nødvendigvis kommer fra personen med høyest tittel, eller fra det lengste møtet.

Søknad

Har du spørsmål om stillingen, hører vi gjerne fra deg.

Vi vet selvfølgelig at de beste kandidatene ikke alltid krysser av på alle punkter. Hvis du har en sterk interesse for kvalitet, teknologi og kontinuerlig læring, og kjenner deg igjen i deler av rollen, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

De fleste av oss matcher jo tross alt ikke 100 prosent med vår egen LinkedIn-profil heller.

Please note that all candidates must be fluent in Norwegian.

Som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess vil identitetsverifisering bli gjennomført ved kontroll av ID-kort, og bakgrunnssjekker kan utføres ved behov.

Om Sogeti

Sogeti, en del av Capgemini Group, gjør teknologi enkelt og verdiskapende. Vi er spesialister på AI-drevne løsninger innen Quality Engineering & Testing, data og cloud, og vi omsetter raskt ideer til handling. Sogeti leverer konkrete resultater, hjelper organisasjoner med å innovere med trygghet og skaper verdi fra dag én. Vi er agile, hurtige og drar nytte av sterke partnerskap.

Våre lokale team jobber side om side med kundene våre og bygger nære relasjoner ved å forstå deres virkelighet. Sammen med Capgemini-konsernets globale styrke og bransjeekspertise skaper vi skalerbare resultater.

Sogeti Norge har 150 ansatte på fem lokasjoner: Oslo, Bergen, Sandefjord, Stavanger og Trondheim. Selskapet er ledende på Quality Engineering & Testing i Norge.

new_jobs.title: (Senior) Power Apps & Web Application Developer (Dynamics 365 & Dataverse)
new_jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
Build the digital backbone that powers our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance teams

Do you want to be hands-on in building the platform that powers how we manage every investment, from lead through to exit? And are you ready to take technical ownership of a growing, business-critical application that combines low-code Power Apps with modern JavaScript/Node.js web development, used every day by our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance colleagues?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

A hands-on, technically deep role at the centre of our internal Investment Management application, spanning both Power Platform and custom web application development
Close collaboration with our Business Application Manager and external development resources, as part of a small, focused core development team
The opportunity to shape a platform still early in its journey — with a clear roadmap and real influence over how it evolves, including its growing web application layer

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting more than 25 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

The team:
A place where great ideas can come from anyone
Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

On this application specifically, you will work day-to-day alongside our Business Application Manager, who coordinates prioritisation and the release process, and a small pool of external developers who provide specialist and overflow capacity. Together, you form the core development team — working closely with Product Owners, Super Users, and functional subject-matter experts from Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to keep the backlog moving and the platform improving.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

You develop and evolve our internal investment management application

Our internal Investment Management application is built on Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, and the Dynamics 365 platform (using only capabilities that do not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence). It supports the full investment lifecycle — from lead and screening, through portfolio management and monitoring, to exit. Alongside this low-code foundation, an increasing share of the application is built as custom web applications — using JavaScript and Node.js — to deliver functionality that goes beyond what Power Apps supports out of the box.

We are looking for a Power Apps & Web Application Developer to take day-to-day technical ownership of the application's codebase and configuration and be the technical lead for the application and its growth over the coming years. You will work closely with our Business Application Manager and external developer resources as the core development team, turning a continuously prioritised backlog into reliable, well-built functionality for the business — spanning both the Power Platform and our custom web application components. You will take the lead on deciding when a requirement is best solved with low-code Power Apps versus custom web development, in dialogue with the Business Application Manager.

You will, for example:
Platform development:
design, build, and maintain Power Apps (model-driven and canvas) and Dataverse solution components — tables, relationships, business rules, and automation — that underpin the application
Web application development:
design, build, and maintain custom web applications and services using JavaScript and Node.js, extending the platform beyond native Power Apps capabilities and integrating tightly with Dataverse via APIs
Dynamics 365 configuration:
configure and extend Dynamics 365 platform capabilities used within the application, strictly limited to functionality that does not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence
Process automation:
build Power Automate flows that automate approvals, notifications, and data flows between the application, our ERP, and other enterprise systems
Backlog delivery:
work from the prioritised Kanban backlog together with the Business Application Manager, who owns the board and coordinates prioritisation and release
Requirements translation:
engage directly with super users and functional SMEs across Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to understand needs and translate them into technical designs
Collaboration with external resources:
coordinate day-to-day with external developers on shared backlog items, ensuring consistent quality, patterns, and documentation across the codebase
Testing and release:
support structured testing cycles and releases, working with super users to validate functionality before it reaches the wider organisation
Production support:
troubleshoot and resolve issues in the live application — both the Power Platform components and the custom web application layer — protecting data integrity and keeping the platform reliable for daily use
Documentation:
maintain clear technical documentation of the data model, configurations, and customisations to support governance and knowledge transfer

You bring hands-on Power Platform and web development skills, and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and modern web development, you become invested in turning business requirements from investment, risk, valuation, or finance stakeholders into robust, well-structured solutions.

We imagine that you:
Technical foundation:
have a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience
Platform expertise:
have solid hands-on experience developing with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), and Power Automate
Web development skills:
have solid hands-on experience building web applications and services with JavaScript and Node.js, and are comfortable working across both front-end and back-end code
Dynamics 365 knowledge:
understand Dynamics 365 as a platform, including entity modelling, business rules, and security roles
Collaborative delivery:
are comfortable working from a shared, continuously prioritised backlog alongside a Business Application Manager and external developers
Communication:
communicate clearly with both technical colleagues and non-technical business stakeholders across departments
Problem-solving:
take a structured, hands-on approach to troubleshooting issues in a live, business-critical application
Have experience with plugin development (C#) or PCF component development on the Power Platform
Are familiar with Azure DevOps and ALM practices for Power Platform and web application deployment

Bonus points if you:
Have experience with modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries (such as React, Vue, or Express) for building web applications
Having domain knowledge from investment management, risk, valuation, or finance processes, is a plus
Have experience from the financial sector or an impact-focused organisation, is a plus

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve, with a growing web application layer alongside it. As Power Apps & Web Application Developer, you will work with:
Microsoft Dataverse (our core data platform for this application)
Microsoft Power Apps (model-driven and canvas apps)
Microsoft Power Automate
JavaScript and Node.js for custom web application and API development
Dynamics 365 as a platform (excluding functionality requiring a Dynamics 365 Sales licence)
Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O), as an integrated neighbouring system
Azure DevOps for backlog, source control, and release management
Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

What we offer

An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact
A focused, hands-on role with real ownership of a growing, business-critical platform
A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment
Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning
A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

Ready to build the backbone of our investment, risk and finance operations?

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply.

CVs not submitted via the platform will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

If you are passionate about cloud software development, team collaboration, and creating outstanding backend code, join Spirii's fantastic growth journey to lead the way for a sustainable future.

Spirii develops and provides world-class charging products and digital solutions to customers with electric cars. Our Digital Development department is proud to drive a listen, learn, and lead culture that allows us to constantly improve our ways of working, including how we adopt AI to raise the quality and speed of our engineering.

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer in our Payments team within the Engineering department, you will help enhance the backbone of the Spirii platform that turns charging data into accurate invoices, credit memos, and payouts. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with CPH and near-shore colleagues, as well as Finance and partner teams.

Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure backend services and cloud-native queue-based pipelines (Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript) that power data ingestion, processing, and invoice generation at high throughput.
Ensuring data quality through correct aggregation and safe handling of late or updated records.
Building and maintaining integrations with internal services and our ERP system.
Significantly contributing to architectural decisions and solution design for cloud-native, distributed, event-driven systems on AWS.
Driving automated testing and observability to protect billing correctness and catch data discrepancies early.
Mentoring other engineers and raising the technical bar of the team through code review, pairing, and constructive feedback.
Operating independently on ambiguous, cross-team problems with minimal oversight.
Using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to accelerate development and automate repetitive tasks while helping the team adopt AI safely in a financially sensitive codebase.

Who You Are

Like to explore innovative technologies, including AI tools and agentic workflows, and continuously expand your skills.
Ambitious and execution-focused, with strong ability to balance functional and non-functional requirements when designing solutions.
A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership of complex backend systems and actively maintaining operational awareness.
Skilled at breaking down complex, ambiguous initiatives into vertical slices that deliver value incrementally; you default to shipping in small, regular batches rather than big-bang releases.
Comfortable working in Agile, cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, Finance, partners), and an active participant in creating an open, collaborative environment.
Excellent English communication skills and the ability to interact with all levels of the organization, internally and externally with partners/customers.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
7+ years of professional software development experience.
Extensive hands-on experience designing and scaling production backend systems, including having designed event-driven, queue/job-based architectures.
Strong experience building TypeScript or JavaScript (Node.js, NestJS) microservices on cloud platforms such as AWS.
Experience leading design discussions, mentoring engineers, or acting as a technical point of contact for a team or domain.
Hands-on experience with test-driven development, test automation, integration and load testing.
Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with the discipline needed for financially accurate, auditable data.
Experience integrating external and internal IT systems, and solid API design.
Experience with developing secure software is a plus.
Knowledge of Redis and NoSQL databases is an advantage.
Experience working with or integrating ERP systems (e.g. Microsoft Business Central) is an advantage.
Experience with billing, payments, invoicing, or other financial/transactional systems is a strong plus.
Hands-on experience using AI assistants and/or agentic workflows to improve engineering productivity is a plus.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.

Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. The SE must influence and support senior technical leaders in our customer accounts to remove blockers, qualify technical risk, create repeatable patterns, and help progress opportunities across regions.

Responsibilities

Own the technical strategy for assigned customers across the customer adoption journey from discovery through technical to close, MVP, pilot, and production adoption and scaling phases.
Lead architecture-led customer conversations across Azure AI, application innovation, data platforms, developer tools, cloud operations, governance, and security topics.

Experience with competitive positioning and objection handling in AI, cloud platform, data, or developer tool markets.
Spoken and written Mandarin fluency is a nice-to-have but not strictly required.

What good looks like

Customer obsessed: earns trust with senior technical leaders by combining curiosity, clarity, and practical technical depth.
Hands-on and credible: can whiteboard, demo, prototype, and pressure-test an architecture rather than simply presenting slides.
Commercially aware: connects technical decisions to pipeline, consumption, revenue, growth, risk reduction, and customer outcomes.

.
Estabilidad, crecimiento profesional y tecnología aplicada a proyectos reales.

ASP.NET (.NET 8), Azure, REST APIs, Entity Framework, JavaScript, React y buenas prácticas de desarrollo basadas en SOLID.
